description: HIGH-RISK paper book requested as a harsher crypto strategy. Each week-end hold 50% of capital in IBIT and 50% in ETHA, scaled by how many of the 50/100/200-session simple moving averages each ETF's last close is above; unallocated capital is held in SHY. Unleveraged. Backtest on BTC-USD/ETH-USD sampled on NYSE sessions, 7 bp per side: 2018-2026 CAGR 36% vs 29% buy-and-hold, vol 46%, max drawdown -60% vs -88%; out of sample 2022-2026 +10.9% vs +1.5%, max drawdown -39% vs -69%. Expect swings of roughly +/-9% in 15 days and drawdowns of 40% or more; no profit claim. Leverage and the 15-minute binary markets were tested and rejected (research/review_2026_10_05/).

risk.note: Disaster brake only; the trend rule is the real exit.

costs.note: Per-side cost applied as an adverse price adjustment (buys fill higher, sells lower). Covers half-spread plus slippage; deliberately conservative for liquid large caps.
